verdict.rationale: The evidence describes workflow results retrievable via webhook or polling and a 'document report' concept, but nothing explicitly confirms that structured fields (name, DOB, document number, address, expiry) are returned as retrievable API data rather than a report/pass-fail outcome. Missing for 10: explicit API/webhook payload schema or docs showing per-field extracted data (name, DOB, doc number, address, expiry) returned to developers.
